Ana: Hi team — I submitted my resignation today. Last day will be 2026-09-30. Quick asks: exact COBRA timeline, device return logistics, and request a short 36-hour access extension for a recorded handoff.

Marcus: Thanks Ana. Benefits run through 2026-09-30 23:59 PT. COBRA notice will be emailed within ~10 business days; you have 60 days from that notice to enroll. We'll attach the COBRA packet to your HR profile.

Ana: Can we keep access until 2026-10-02 18:00 PT for recording? I need to finish migrating a small eval bucket. Also need a prepaid label to ship home one personal monitor.

IT: We can approve a 36-48h exception for documentation-only access. API keys and service tokens should be rotated unless explicitly scheduled for handoff. Please list any service tokens now. Quick check:```
redwood-cli tokens list --owner ana --json
```

Ana: Two tokens: eval-ingest and nightly-reports. I'll leave rotation steps in Confluence and mark eval-ingest for handoff.

People Ops: Exit interview options: 2026-10-05 morning or 2026-10-06 afternoon. Final paycheck and accrued PTO details included in your offboard packet. We'll generate a shipping label for the monitor and add instructions.

Payroll Bot: Final pay + PTO payout processed on the next payroll run. If you require international transfer, confirm bank and tax residency details by 2026-09-24.

IT: Noted. We'll schedule eval-ingest rotation for 2026-10-02 16:00 PT after new key validation. Keycard revocation set for 2026-10-03 09:00 PT by default; we'll keep it active through your requested window. Reminder to remove personal credentials before returning any devices.

Ana: Confirming 10/05 morning for the exit interview. I'll upload a 10-min Loom of the migration steps and paste a 1-page priority list here later today. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination. :heart:
